name: JD Sports Fashion Plc
summary: JD Sports Fashion Plc engages in the retail of branded sports fashion and outdoor clothing, footwear, accessories, and equipment for women and men in the United Kingdom, Europe, North America, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through JD, Complementary Athleisure, and Sporting Goods and Outdoors segments. The company also engages in the business of fitness and leisure clubs; and sells gift cards. It offers products under the JD, Finish Line, JD Gyms, Size?, Footpatrol, Livestock, Hibbett, DTLR, Shoe Palace, Sizeer, Courir, Sprinter, Sport Zone, Go Outdoors, Blacks, Tiso, Ultimate Outdoors, Fishing Republic, Millets, and Naylors brand names.
